# CueNow 1.4.51
## Fixes
- Fixed the CueNow menu bar icon disappearing when another app's icon was hidden from System Settings on macOS 26. CueNow's menu bar item had no name of its own, so macOS grouped it with every other unnamed menu bar item — including Cursor, Codex and Claude — under a single shared visibility switch. - CueNow's menu bar icon now has its own visibility switch and is unaffected by other apps. Its position in the menu bar is preserved when updating.

# CueNow 1.4.5
- Fixed numbered list markers displaying in a different font from their list text on older macOS versions. - Corrected inconsistent numbered-list line spacing caused by those mixed font metrics.

## What’s fixed
- Ordered lists now keep the same font, wrapping, and line spacing across every item on older macOS versions. - CueNow no longer lets the system’s automatic text replacement compete with its numbered-list editor, preventing malformed `1.Text` formatting. - Glass notes on macOS 15 and earlier now use a translucent, appearance-adaptive background in both Light and Dark Mode. - Shared diagnostic logs now include the macOS version, appearance, transparency setting, and note style to make display-specific reports actionable.
